## Où j'en suis
Prepared the Postgres 17 blue/green upgrade for `analytics-staging`: parameter group family derived from the major version, blue/green enabled, engine 16.4 → 17.2, AWS provider pinned and `tflint` clean; prod is prepared behind `pg17_enabled = false`. Nothing has been applied — staging plan is 1 to add / 1 to change and prod plan is empty — and PR #57 is open as a draft with the pg_partman and dbt-lock caveats in its description.

- [prochaine-étape] Upgrade pg_partman 4.7.4 → 5.1.0 on 16.4 and verify `run_maintenance_proc()` on `events_raw`/`events_daily` before any staging apply
- [prochaine-étape] Pick a prod window after Maya's sign-off, outside the 01:00–03:30 UTC dbt lock
- [essai-raté] `init -upgrade` selected AWS provider v6 and produced 37 unrelated changes; reverted
- [décision] Pin AWS provider ~> 5.82.0, no v6 in this PR (source: t04)
- [décision] Plan only, nothing applied (source: t01)
- [décision] No prod date and `apply_immediately = false` until Maya signs off (source: t14)
